name: mobile
_doc: The Mobile pack (owner request R-0239): 3 mob-* SPECIALIST agents (never Bosses; the 12 permanent Bosses are unchanged) for mobile apps (Capacitor, Expo, React Native, Flutter; apk and aab). Evidence: the Forge phone app (command-center/mobile) and 100 apps. forge-router sends a mobile request to this pack; forge-pack.cjs (doctor check packs) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. Presets are expanded by forge-lane-skills.cjs (--require mobile-all,process): every mobile lane opens every mobile-all and process skill first. Signing keys, store uploads and publishing stay owner gates.
